capabilities: Flash wikilink brackets when a link is created
Flash brackets when the cursor moves into an existing wikilink
Customize flash colour, bracket text colour, opacity, duration, and corner radius per light/dark theme
Preview and replay flash animations in settings
Trigger a test flash on the wikilink under the cursor via a command
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Works only in Live Preview and Source editing modes; respects the system Reduce Motion setting; local-only with no network requests.
intentEvidence: the same momentary cue Xcode gives when you close a {} block and it flashes the matching brace
motivation: The author wanted the same momentary bracket-flash cue Xcode gives when closing a code block.
problem: Obsidian gives no momentary visual cue when a wikilink is created or when the cursor enters one, making it easy to lose track of link boundaries while typing or navigating.

relations.evidence: the same momentary cue Xcode gives when you close a {} block

summary: Editor decoration plugin that briefly flashes a wikilink's [[ ]] brackets when you create one or move the cursor into it.
